description: This file defines the CurlFactory class responsible for creating and managing cURL handles for HTTP requests within the Guzzle HTTP client library. It includes methods for creating cURL options, handling SSL configurations, managing handle resources, and processing request/response lifecycle events.

classes.name: CurlFactory
classes.description: Handles creation, configuration, and management of cURL resources for HTTP requests within Guzzle, supporting features like HTTP/2, SSL/TLS configurations, handle pooling, and error handling.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and configures a new EasyHandle for the given HTTP request and options.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases a cURL handle back into the pool or closes it if the pool is full.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Completes the cURL transaction, returning a fulfilled or rejected promise based on the outcome.

methods.name: supportsHttp2
methods.description: Checks if the current cURL build supports HTTP/2.

methods.name: supportsTls12
methods.description: Checks if the current cURL build supports TLS 1.2.

methods.name: supportsTls13
methods.description: Checks if the current cURL build supports TLS 1.3.

methods.name: getCurlVersion
methods.description: Returns the current cURL version string.

methods.name: createHeaderFn
methods.description: Creates a callback function to process HTTP headers received during the request.
